heading: Stock split alert: Record date soon - shares jump 121% in 2 yrs | Do you own?
author: LiveMint Editorial
paragraphs: Naturite Agro Products Limited shares rose by 8.24% on September 21, before a stock split record date set. The split will divide each equity share of Rs. 10 into two shares of Rs. 5, requiring ownership before the record date for eligibility.
